---
title: "More Than Two Variables"
---

Real questions rarely stop at two variables. A house's price depends on its size, but also on its location and its age; attrition in the work-from-home experiment depended on treatment, but managers and non-managers responded differently. This chapter extends the two-variable tools --- crosstabs, grouped summaries, scatterplots --- to three or more variables at once, using color, faceting, and conditioning to add dimensions.
